summary: Primary composition: six-panel workplace comic page in the established Break Room, continuing directly from Page 1. Kreeb tries to help Zib repair the taped-off microwave by clearing the counter and shifting communal objects. His rearranging displaces Glorp's cherished cracked blue-striped mug and Pixa's charging setup. Meanwhile Glorp's well-meant laminated notice blocks the outlet Zib needs. Every coworker is trying to help, but their overlapping efforts keep the microwave unusable. Jax's soup remains unheated.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Close on Glorp's newly laminated sign beside the same taped-off microwave, readable only: DO NOT PROCESS SOUP AS A GROUP. Jax, still holding the same covered soup bowl from Page 1, leans in to read it. Preserve the established Break Room's counter, shelving, outlet, refrigerator and window orientation. The sign and Jax's reaction are the focus.

PANEL 2 — On the shared counter and shelf near the kettle, Kreeb tidies up to give Zib room to work. He moves Glorp's old chipped blue-striped mug to the communal shelf. Glorp, nearby finishing the laminated notice, immediately recognizes his mug and approaches. Their lines must be visibly motivated by the mug being moved, not by the microwave.

PANEL 3 — Glorp retrieves his chipped blue-striped mug from the communal shelf and holds it protectively. Kreeb still has his cleaning cloth and reacts with sincere confusion. Show the mug's crack and established blue stripe. Do not imply it is trash; it is clearly Glorp's personal item.

PANEL 4 — Return to the established microwave counter: Zib, acting as a competent technician, carefully lifts the corner of Glorp's fresh laminated sign to access the same wall outlet partially obscured beside/behind the microwave, holding an ordinary diagnostic lead. Glorp turns sharply toward the peeling noise with the cracked mug still held securely, and worries about the laminate. Keep microwave, wall, counter edge and outlet geometry stable. No damage to the appliance, no invented electronic error display.

PANEL 5 — Pixa enters carrying her charging lead and discovers the practical consequence of Kreeb's rearrangement: the kettle now occupies her usual charging space; her moved charging tray is too far from the established wall outlet, and the lead stops visibly short. Kreeb looks from the kettle to the short lead and realizes his well-meant change caused the problem. Do not change Pixa's approved humanoid white-and-blue machine body or invent a new charging outlet.

PANEL 6 — Jax sets his covered soup bowl briefly on the same counter, takes in the crowded notice, displaced belongings, Zib's blocked access and Pixa's short charger, then retrieves the bowl. His expression shifts from irritation to dry reluctant agreement with the sign. The microwave remains taped off and unrepaired. Conclude on Jax's low-key character reaction; no group victory or resolution.
